Dataset Summary
	

The DSC-Benchmark (Diverse, Simple, and Categorized Benchmark) is designed to evaluate the robustness and decision-making capabilities of Large Language Model (LLM) routers. It encompasses a diverse set of tasks, including coding, translation, mathematics, human instructions, general knowledge, and adversarial prompts (e.g., jailbreaking attempts).
